name: 55107 · Saint Paul, MN
findings: ZIP 55107 (Saint Paul) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55107 (Saint Paul) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55107 (Saint Paul) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
